verdict.rationale: A live probe returned HTTP 200 at docs.readme.com/llms.txt, which tells agents to append .md to any page URL for markdown. Section-level llms.txt files exist across the docs tree, and ReadMe documents AI discoverability scoring against the Agent-Friendly Docs spec, so agents can be pointed straight at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents consuming these llms.txt/.md endpoints in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Append .md to any documentation page URL to
